title: Armored Warrior with Red Umbrella
description: A woman in ornate bronze and steel armor stands atop a crimson battlefield. She holds a large open red umbrella with a gothic spire handle in one hand and a large rifle in the other, wearing a long dark red skirt with keys dangling from her belt.
prompt: A stern woman with pale skin and dark braided hair stands on a blood-red desolate battlefield under a stormy sky. She wears intricate bronze and steel plate armor over a long dark red skirt, holds a large open red umbrella with a gothic cathedral spire handle, and carries a heavy rifle. Keys and ammunition hang from her belt, ruined spires and debris litter the ground behind her, dramatic cinematic lighting, painted fantasy style
